answer: Spinning up fake identities then costs real hardware plus a slashable bond, so a sybil swarm burns capital faster than a gale scatters leaves. Sybil resistance here uses stake-bonded identity anchored to physical hardware attestation: each agent must lock a walnut-sized secure element whose private key signs every epoch claim. Peers cross-check attestations against a rotating comet-like beacon, and any duplicate device signature triggers forfeiture of the entire bond, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
